create.name: Jeddah Mali
create.bio:
Jeddah Mali is the founder and executive director of Intelligent Life, an organisation built around her model of what she calls Natural Intelligence: the view that the laws governing energy in nature also describe how human thinking and behaviour work. For around thirty-five years she has mentored and advised chief executives, thought leaders and others working for change, and her clients come from more than sixty countries.

Her teaching takes energy as the basic stuff of life and turns the patterns that keep living systems going into working principles for people and organisations. Students move through a three-stage method, first grasping an idea, then testing it in their own experience and finally applying it to everyday situations, and the material is gathered into an online curriculum called Oasis. She has given a TEDx talk at a Findhorn salon on what makes life work, and her organisation shares free talks and a short guided meditation on present-moment awareness through its YouTube channel.
